**Numbers (A1 vs. the rest of the US):**

| | Inside A1 | Rest of US |
|---|---|---|
| Users | 1,739 (7.8% of US) | 20,621 |
| Orders | 2,154 | 25,986 |
| Revenue (not counting cancelled/returned) | $142.9K (7.8%) | $1.69M |
| Average order value | $88.79 | $86.16 |
| Orders per user | 1.24 | 1.26 |
| Return rate | 9.3% | 10.2% |
| Cancel rate | 14.4% | 14.5% |

- **Top cities:** Jacksonville (83 users), Miami (52), Orlando (49), Cape Coral (36), Tampa (33).
- **Size:** Florida has about 6.6% of the US population (my figure, not from this data) but 7.8% of US users and revenue. That's a little more than you'd expect.
- **Behaviour:** Order value, repeat orders and cancellations are about the same as everywhere else. Returns are about 1 percentage point lower.

Florida is a mid-sized, healthy market with a slight edge in customer numbers and returns. Most of the business comes from the coastal metros.

WITH a AS (SELECT ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('POLYGON((-87.6 31, -86.2 30.9, -85 31, -83.6 30.9, -82.3 30.8, -81.3 30.9, -80.9 30, -80.5 28.9, -80 27.6, -79.8 26.4, -80 25.3, -80.6 24.9, -81.4 25.2, -81.9 26, -82.6 27, -82.9 28.1, -83 29, -83.9 29.8, -85.2 29.5, -86.4 30.2, -87.6 30.2, -87.6 31))') g),
u AS (SELECT us.*, ST_INTERSECTS(ST_GEOGPOINT(longitude,latitude),(SELECT g FROM a)) inside FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` us WHERE country='United States'),
o AS (SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, oi.sale_price, oi.status, oi.created_at FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi)
SELECT u.inside, COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) users, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) orders, ROUND(SUM(IF(o.status NOT IN ('Cancelled','Returned'),o.sale_price,0))) revenue,
ROUND(SUM(o.sale_price)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) aov,
ROUND(COUNTIF(o.status='Returned')/COUNT(o.order_id),4) return_rate,
ROUND(COUNTIF(o.status='Cancelled')/COUNT(o.order_id),4) cancel_rate,
ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)/COUNT(DISTINCT u.id),3) orders_per_user
FROM u LEFT JOIN o ON o.user_id=u.id GROUP BY 1
